headline: Budget process and schedule, third readings of policies on student harassment and staff-student electronic communications, and two monitoring reports.
summary: The agenda covers budget planning, two policy third readings, and monitoring reports on asset protection and compensation and benefits. It also includes a SouthPoint tour, a Chittenden Central CESA update, and a resignation.
items: Closed executive session on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Tour of SouthPoint at 577 Dorset Street, open to community members
Public comments on any topic, up to 3 minutes each
Third reading of Policy F4 on investigating and responding to harassment, hazing, and bullying of students
Third reading of Policy D9 on electronic communications between employees and students
The Other Paper article calendar and production process
Act 170 Merger Committee update on the November 2 meeting
Action on Monitoring Report 2.7 Asset Protection, presented by Jean-Marie Clark
Action on Monitoring Report 2.8 Compensation and Benefits, presented by Daisy Brayton
Consent agenda: resignation of Deborah Baker-Moody, 1.0 FTE Project SEARCH Regional Program for District, and setting the agenda for the November 18, 2026 meeting
Review of future agenda items and parking lot
location: 577 Dorset Street, South Burlington School District
